evidence: A box model on committed products: the air and its 400 ppm of CO2, the design case's temperatures, the drainage's runoff and lakes, the atlas's seas, C''s land uses with the food blend, the gas ledger's methane, the sky ecology's aerophytes, resources' dredged deltas and its kilns. Its rates are Earth measurements carried to the Moon (the basalt weathering law, field ageing, biome inventories, lake and marine burial, peat and desert carbonate) beside design guesses, each labelled in the assumptions; its carbonate chemistry uses published constants at the design temperatures. A runnable calculation with checked conservation and step convergence: ecosystems, sediments and the seas enter as well-mixed boxes with Earth rates, and no lunar measurement stands behind any rate.
reading_rule: Carbon in Gt C (1e12 kg of carbon) and Gt C a year unless a key names Gt CO2, mol or kg; gases in ppm of the dry air; waters in meq or mmol per kg; power in GW; years from the seeding of the biosphere. Corners pair the low ends of every input (the smallest stocks and sinks), their middles and their high ends; the middle of the fresh-soil factor is geometric. Held runs keep CO2 at 400 ppm: their import is what the managed return leaves, and their net sink is what the Moon's reservoirs take from the air before any return. Free runs start from the held run at the year the biosphere is grown. Rates at a year are the mean over the step that ends there; the first year carries the first step's.

assumptions.name: co2_ppm
assumptions.basis: held at the level the planned climate was run with: 48.6 Pa in the design's 121.6 kPa of dry air

assumptions.name: methane_held_ppm
assumptions.basis: the author's choice of 13 October, Earth's present methane, the balanced middle of three pairs weighed (domain/ecology, domain synthesis, gases.held); 90% of the sources cut at the sources, the rest oxidized by the soils and by contactors in open air

assumptions.name: methane_soils_case_ppm
assumptions.basis: no cut and no removal: the gas ledger's central sources at the blend's two ends over the soils' central sink; the central corner takes their mean

assumptions.name: temperatures_k
assumptions.basis: the corrected design case A28_dim5_moon, years 20-29 (climate/gcm/README.md); weathering and the lakes at the air over land, the seas at the sea surface

assumptions.name: runoff_mm_yr
assumptions.basis: the drainage product's discharge to the seas over the atlas's land, lakes included, as resources/industry.py runoff_mm() reads it

assumptions.name: weathering_law
assumptions.basis: Dessert et al. (2003) for basaltic catchments, CO2 consumed = runoff x a exp(b T); the highlands weather like basalt through their anorthite (resources finding 5)

assumptions.name: fresh_soil_factor
assumptions.basis: the developed soils start at this multiple of the catchment rate, within the CO2 study's 1-10 for fine glassy ground

assumptions.name: soil_age_at_start_yr
assumptions.basis: the soils' age when the biosphere is seeded, made in the build's last centuries; they age as (1 + t/age)^-0.61 toward the catchment rate

assumptions.name: age_exponent
assumptions.basis: field rates fall as t^-0.61 (White & Brantley 2003)

assumptions.name: cation_shares
assumptions.basis: the highland soil's Ca, Mg, Na and K (the lunar-cycle register, from the Lunar Sourcebook), released in proportion; its 5.1 wt% FeO oxidized as the rock weathers

assumptions.name: biomes_gt_c
assumptions.basis: plants and the top metre of soil by biome (IPCC TAR WG1 Table 3.2, WBGU column): area 10^6 km2, plants, soils

assumptions.name: rain_regions
assumptions.basis: wet land in bands of at least 2 mm a day holds tropical forest, the rest of the wet land savanna, the fog desert and polar dry land desert; the kept wild and the parks hold their region's wild stock

assumptions.name: land_uses
assumptions.evidence: project product with a design mapping
assumptions.basis: the synthesis ledgers: fields and settlements on the forest region at cropland stocks, heritage pasture on the savanna region (the middle-wet homestead belt) at savanna stocks; the low corner takes the blend's high-cost end with 2 kg of meat a person, the high corner the low-cost end with 0.5 kg

assumptions.name: plant_growth_years
assumptions.basis: logistic growth from a 1% seed to 90% of the stock: forest regrowth in about 50 years (the CO2 study, Poorter et al. 2016), five years for fields, settlements and pasture

assumptions.name: soil_build_kg_c_m2_yr
assumptions.basis: Post & Kwon (2000) on establishment: the soils approach their stock on the forest's time, 372 years, in every class; the slow-soil variant takes five times as long

assumptions.name: starting_stocks
assumptions.basis: shares of the mature stocks at the seeding

assumptions.name: wet_margins_share_of_moon
assumptions.basis: the ecology screen's wetland scenario, central 2.6%, on the forest region

assumptions.name: peat_g_c_m2_yr
assumptions.basis: Holocene peat accumulation (Loisel et al. 2014), following the wet margins' plants

assumptions.name: soil_carbonate_g_c_m2_yr
assumptions.basis: pedogenic carbonate in Mojave Aridisols (Schlesinger 1985) over the fog desert and polar dry land; its calcium comes from silicate, so each carbon is a sink

assumptions.name: lake_burial_g_c_m2_yr
assumptions.basis: lakes and reservoirs (Mendonca et al. 2017) over the rain-fed lakes, following the land's plants

assumptions.name: sea_burial_g_c_m2_yr
assumptions.basis: Earth's unvegetated shelves and deep sea (Duarte et al. 2005) on the seas' 14% under 200 m and the rest; the rivers bring the seas little phosphorus, so these are upper bounds

assumptions.name: dredging
assumptions.basis: the people's phosphorus losses dredged back from the lake deltas (the synthesis ledger, resources' routes), the sediment at Earth's deltaic and shelf organic content (Hedges & Keil 1995, Berner 1982) and respired on the farms

assumptions.name: waters
assumptions.value: well mixed, in CO2 equilibrium with the air
assumptions.basis: checks.exchange gives the time to equilibrium

assumptions.name: lake_passage_share
assumptions.basis: the share of the land's runoff that crosses a rain-fed lake (the routing); the rest reaches the seas directly

assumptions.name: calcite_saturation_held
assumptions.basis: calcifiers precipitate calcite wherever fresh water stands above three times saturation; salted seas keep the saturation they arrive with

assumptions.name: salted_seas
assumptions.basis: Earth's seawater delivered with the water

assumptions.name: carbonate_constants
assumptions.basis: Plummer & Busenberg (1982), Harned & Owen and Davies in fresh water; Weiss (1974), Lueker et al. (2000), Dickson (1990), Uppstrom (1974), Millero (1995) and Mucci (1983) in seawater; no ion pairs

assumptions.name: sky
assumptions.basis: cover 0.1%, 1% and 2%, its class shares and its bodies' standing host carbon at the reference light; logistic growth at the class-weighted growth rates

assumptions.name: people
assumptions.basis: C''s 8 billion from the seeding; the diet's food grown with its losses (the food study) held for half a year; the built stocks' wood and polymers

assumptions.name: kilns
assumptions.value: all carbonate calcined as it forms
assumptions.basis: the managed return that keeps the carbonate sediments from growing; the lime and magnesia kept from the air, sealed or built in; a share f that takes CO2 back raises the load by 1/(1 - f)

assumptions.name: kiln_energy_gj_t_co2
assumptions.basis: calcination at its minimum and the best lime kilns (Schorcht et al. 2013); magnesite's kilns scaled by the lime kilns' ratio

assumptions.name: magnesite_route
assumptions.basis: the lakes' new magnesium made into MgCO3 where the rivers enter, then calcined; the route's own energy is outside the model

assumptions.name: free_run
assumptions.basis: kilns, the magnesite route and the import stop; dredging and the methane hold go on; weathering cools with the forcing over the GCM's feedback and loses the plants' help as CO2 falls; the land's and the sky's stocks follow the leaf rate

assumptions.name: feedback_w_m2_k
assumptions.basis: the GCM's 1.0-1.6 W m-2 K-1 as the CO2 study gives it; the forcing from the radiative-convective CO2 sweep

assumptions.name: fert
assumptions.basis: GEOCARB III, eq 5 (Berner & Kothavala 2001)
